blocks.zh: 可复用的踢球模型也有不同来源：固定教学模型 kick-teacher.onnx 来自 Pollen Robotics 发布的 ball_kick_right.onnx；课程另外保留了自行训练的踢球残差模型。选择哪一个，就需要围绕它实际接受的输入、启动条件和恢复过程准备示范，不能混用两者的动作含义。
blocks.en: Reusable kick models have different origins: the fixed kick-teacher.onnx is Pollen Robotics’ published ball_kick_right.onnx; a separately trained course kick residual is also retained. Demonstrations must match the selected model’s inputs, entry conditions and recovery behavior.

blocks.zh: 动作接口可以是连续的速度请求，也可以加入技能触发信号。若需要触发一次踢腿，执行层还必须检查当前姿态与速度，避免连续触发，等待技能结束后再恢复行走控制。这些执行约束与模型学会“什么时候适合出脚”相互配合；它们不会因为换成大模型而自动消失。
blocks.en: An action interface may combine continuous movement requests with skill triggers. A kick executor must check posture and speed, prevent repeated triggers, and return control after the skill ends. These execution constraints complement the learned timing decision.

blocks.zh: 用传统控制器生成示范是自然的起点：让它在仿真中完成任务，记录图像、状态与高层请求，再用这些数据微调 GR00T。即使老师通过几何计算确定站位，学生模型也可以学习从观察到请求的映射。老师的失败不会自动变成正确标签；成功示范也不能代替独立测试，更不能保证模型已经掌握陌生任务。
blocks.en: A traditional controller is a useful demonstration source: run the task in simulation, record observations and high-level requests, and fine-tune GR00T. Even if the teacher computes geometric target poses, the learner can learn an observation-to-request mapping. Failed teacher actions are not automatically valid labels, and successful demonstrations do not replace held-out evaluation or establish new-task ability.

blocks.zh: 步行示范由相机、IMU、编码器与 ToF 驱动的传统控制器生成，不读取球或球门的世界真值。下面的轮滑动手练习使用另一位仿真专家，它可读取精确球位置与速度来生成动作标签；这些特权信息不作为学习策略的输入。比较两种模式时要区分老师的观测能力。能够从标准起点生成示范，也不等于能够接管并修复学习策略造成的各种偏差。
blocks.en: Walking demonstrations come from an engineered controller driven by RGB, IMU, encoders and ToF, without world-coordinate ball or goal truth. The roller exercises below use a different simulation expert that can access exact ball position and velocity to generate labels; those privileged values are excluded from learner inputs. Distinguish the experts’ observations across modes. Demonstrating from a standard start does not establish recovery from learner-induced errors.

blocks.zh: 这里的“串起任务”可以表现为持续观察并生成合适的动作请求，不要求模型先写出一份文字步骤表。第八章再讨论如何由 ASPIRE 在更长任务中组织技能、检查结果并决定是否重试。
blocks.en: Connecting task stages can mean repeatedly observing and producing suitable action requests; a written plan is not required. Chapter 8 considers ASPIRE for longer-horizon skill organization, outcome checks and retries.

title.zh: 步行射门：GR00T 接收什么、输出什么
title.en: Walking shots: what goes into and comes out of GR00T

blocks.zh: 步行射门采用分层控制：GR00T 读取相机、任务指令和机器人状态，预测身体运动、头部运动与踢球请求；执行层复用官方行走策略和课程的局部踢球／恢复技能。头部姿态请求表示相对中性位的弧度偏移，实际关节动作仍由底层策略生成。局部踢球技能组合参考踢球、站立策略、课程训练的残差修正与恢复逻辑，并非单独直接运行一个官方踢腿模型。
blocks.en: Walking shots use hierarchical control: GR00T reads images, an instruction and robot state, then predicts body-motion, head-motion and kick requests. The executor reuses the official walking policy and the course’s local kick/recovery skill. Head-pose requests are radian offsets from a neutral pose; the low-level policy still generates joint actions. The local kick combines reference kick/standing policies, a course-trained residual and recovery logic, rather than running a standalone official kick model.

blocks.zh: “任务指令”就是描述期望结果的自然语言，例如“请将足球射进球门”。步行示范使用的英文原文是 <q>Walk to the football, kick it into the goal with the right foot, and recover to standing.</q>，意思是“走向足球，用右脚把球踢进球门，然后恢复站立”。它以文本形式随观察送入模型，不需要人手算球前站位再写进指令；机器人仍须从相机和状态中判断该怎样动作。
blocks.en: A task instruction is natural language describing the desired outcome, such as “Please kick the football into the goal.” The walking demonstrations use the exact text <q>Walk to the football, kick it into the goal with the right foot, and recover to standing.</q> It is passed to the model as text alongside observations. It does not require a hand-calculated stance in the instruction; the robot must infer actions from images and state.

blocks.zh: 输入一条语言指令与学会理解任意指令是两回事。这组示范围绕同一射门目标采集，不能据此推断换成“把球带到桌子旁”就能完成。如果要教多个任务，需要提供相应的指令、观察与动作示范，并在未参与训练的情境中分别验证。
blocks.en: Accepting language does not establish understanding of arbitrary instructions. These demonstrations concern one scoring task; they do not establish that “Take the ball beside the table” will work. Teaching multiple tasks requires matching instructions, observations and actions, followed by held-out evaluation for each task.

zh: 同一个机载视角的当前帧及约 1.92、3.84、5.76 秒前的帧；不是四台相机。
“走向足球，用右脚把球踢进球门，然后恢复站立。”指令随观察一起输入；一种任务的示范不等于任意指令泛化。
机身角速度和重力方向 6；关节位置 14；关节速度 14；上一电机动作 14；上一高层决策请求 8；局部踢球技能忙碌标志和进度 2。
对应三张过去图像，每组包含机身角速度和重力方向 6、头部关节位置 4、上一高层请求 8、历史间隔 1、积分摘要 4。
与图像和文本分开编码。积分摘要来自角速度和运动请求，不能当成精确位置或实测位移。
en: Current frame and frames about 1.92, 3.84 and 5.76 seconds earlier from one onboard camera, not four cameras.
Walk to the football, kick it into the goal with the right foot, and recover to standing. Demonstrating one instruction does not establish arbitrary instruction generalization.
Angular velocity and gravity direction 6; joint positions 14; joint velocities 14; previous motor actions 14; previous high-level decision request 8; local kick busy flag and progress 2.
For each past image: angular velocity and gravity 6, head-joint positions 4, previous high-level request 8, age 1 and integral summaries 4.
Encoded separately from images and text. Gyro/request integrals do not provide exact position or measured displacement.

blocks.zh: 上一电机动作与上一高层请求要分开理解：前者记录底层实际发出的动作，后者记录上一采样时刻 GR00T 提出的 8 维请求。请求可能随后被稳定条件或头部变化速率限制暂缓，不能把“提出请求”当成“已经完成动作”。
blocks.en: Previous motor actions and previous high-level requests are distinct: the former record low-level actions actually issued; the latter record GR00T’s eight requested values at the previous sample. Stability conditions or head rate limits can delay a request, so a request does not establish completed motion.

blocks.zh: 每个预测步输出 8 个数，按下面的顺序解释。前进、横移和转向使用执行接口的请求单位，不能直接当成实测速度；踢球值是触发请求，不是脚部关节角，也不应直接解释为成功概率。
blocks.en: Each predicted step has eight values in the order below. Forward, lateral and yaw values use the executor’s request units, not measured velocities. The kick value is a trigger request, not a foot-joint angle or a calibrated success probability.

zh: 官方行走策略结合身体反馈，连续生成关节动作。
颈部俯仰、头部俯仰／偏航／侧倾请求
相对中性位的弧度姿态请求经过限幅和变化速率限制，交给底层策略生成关节动作。
达到触发阈值后，执行层先处理停车、头部回正和稳定条件，再运行局部踢球与恢复技能。
en: The official walking policy combines requests with body feedback to produce joint actions.
Neck pitch and head pitch/yaw/roll requests
Radian pose offsets from neutral pass through limits and rate limiting; the low-level policy generates joint actions.
After the trigger threshold, the executor manages stopping, head neutralization and stability before the local kick/recovery skill.

blocks.zh: 动作块的形状是 16 × 8：16 是未来时间步数，8 才是每一步的请求维度。先执行其中 4 步，再用新观察重新预测，对应 0.32 秒仿真时间；底层控制仍以 50 Hz 运行。预测未来 16 步不代表增加了 16 个电机，也不代表动作头直接输出底层行走网络的全部关节动作。
blocks.en: The action block is 16 × 8: 16 future time steps, with eight requests at each step. Execute the first four steps, then predict again from fresh observations: 0.32 seconds of simulation time. Low-level control remains at 50 Hz. Predicting 16 steps neither adds motors nor directly predicts all joint actions of the walking network.

blocks.zh: 127 维状态中没有球或球门的仿真世界坐标，也没有传统控制器的任务阶段编号。局部技能的忙碌标志与进度来自执行器自身，可以在机器人端维护。模型需要从图像和运动历史学习何时接近、如何观察、何时请求踢球；触发条件与底层平衡控制仍由执行层负责。
blocks.en: The 127-dimensional state excludes simulated world coordinates of the ball and goal and excludes the traditional controller’s task-stage labels. Local skill activity and progress come from the executor and can be maintained onboard. The model learns approach, observation and kick requests from images and history; entry conditions and low-level balance remain executor responsibilities.

blocks.zh: 下面的轮滑动手练习采用另一套接口：115 维状态历史和每步 4 维请求，始终保持轮滑模式，通过碰球与制动完成任务。它与这里的步行接口不能混用；更换运动方式时，数据、处理器、检查点和执行器必须成套匹配。
blocks.en: The gliding hands-on exercise below uses a separate interface: 115-dimensional state history and four requests per step, remaining in gliding mode through contact and braking. Do not mix it with the walking interface; data, processors, checkpoints and executors must match.

title.zh: 步行模型到底训练了哪些参数

blocks.zh: 把任务指令写成明确的动作目标，例如“走到足球旁，用右脚把球踢进球门，然后恢复站立”。对应英文输入是 Walk to the football, kick it into the goal with the right foot, and recover to standing. 单一任务的示范可以一直使用这条指令；但仅靠这一任务的成功，无法证明模型理解了不同语言目标。
blocks.en: Use an explicit action goal: Walk to the football, kick it into the goal with the right foot, and recover to standing. Demonstrations of one task may share this instruction. Success on that task alone does not establish understanding of different language goals.

blocks.zh: 步行实验采用冻结视觉与语言骨干、训练动作头的方法。训练的部分包括状态与动作编码器、动作解码器、动作序列生成网络，以及动作头中的视觉语言特征处理层。这里不是 LoRA 微调，也不只是把最后一层改为 8 个数。冻结骨干可以预先缓存图像与指令特征，但动作头仍需要真实的梯度更新。
blocks.en: The walking experiment freezes the vision-language backbone and trains the action head: state/action encoders, action decoder, action-sequence generator and feature processing within the head. This is not LoRA and is more than replacing a final layer with eight numbers. Frozen backbone features can be cached, while the action head still receives gradient updates.

blocks.zh: 训练目标是一段 16×8 的专家动作请求；GR00T 内部较宽的动作表示通过有效维度掩码适配这 8 维接口。闭环执行时只取序列前 4 步，再读取新观测预测下一段；在 12.5 Hz 决策采样下，这对应 0.32 秒仿真时间。下层行走策略继续以 50 Hz 驱动电机。仿真等待模型返回结果，并不意味着电脑和真机之间已经满足实时延迟要求。
blocks.en: Training targets are 16×8 expert action requests. An active-dimension mask adapts GR00T’s wider internal action representation to this interface. Closed-loop execution takes the first four steps, then predicts again from fresh observations: 0.32 seconds of simulation time at 12.5 Hz. The lower walking policy still drives motors at 50 Hz. A simulator waiting for inference does not establish real-time performance over a robot–computer network.

blocks.zh: 后面的轮滑练习使用自己的状态与动作接口、训练范围和命令。不要把轮滑检查点送入步行控制器，也不要把一种模式的验证结果当成另一种模式的成功率。
blocks.en: The roller exercises below have their own state/action interface, training scope and commands. Do not load a roller checkpoint into the walking controller or transfer one mode’s success rate to another.

title.zh: 先教好一个简单球场

blocks.zh: 先从已经对齐足球与球门的近球起点学习直线碰球和停车。这个练习的示范没有转向动作，因此不能用它证明模型会寻球、绕行或纠正任意朝向。扩展这些能力时，需要加入对应观察与动作的示范，再分别测试。
blocks.en: Start with straight bumping and stopping from a near-ball position aligned with the goal. These demonstrations contain no turning, so they do not establish search, obstacle avoidance or arbitrary heading recovery. Add corresponding observations and actions before testing those capabilities.

blocks.label: 先有可靠示范，再谈数据规模
nodes: 一种场地与一种运动方式
观察对应实际执行动作
拟合任务中的动作规律
details: 先选一个足球垫和固定背景，球与球门保持同一物理配置。分别学习步行射门和轮滑碰球，先把一种方式做稳，再扩大任务范围。
每条示范需要任务语言、带时间戳的图像和状态，以及与所选动作层级一致的标签。高层 VLA 记录实际采纳的速度或技能请求，低层关节执行值另存；若训练低层动作，则记录限幅等修正后的执行值。等待、复位和失败片段要单独标记。
从基础模型出发，用训练集学习观察到动作的映射。相机帧与动作可能频率不同，要明确时间对应关系，不能按行号硬配。
测试的起点和轨迹不参与训练或调参。看完整进球与稳定结束，也看耗时和重复观察。训练误差低，不等于闭环执行可靠。

english_diagram.label: Reliable demonstrations before scale
details: Choose one mat and background with fixed ball/goal physics. Develop walking and gliding separately; stabilize one mode before broadening scope.

Record instruction, timestamped images/state and labels matching the chosen action level. A high-level VLA learns accepted velocity/skill requests, with joint execution logged separately. Low-level action training uses the values after clipping or correction. Mark waits, resets and failures separately.
Adapt the base model using training examples. Images and actions can have different rates; align timestamps rather than blindly matching row numbers.
Keep evaluation starts and trajectories out of training and tuning. Measure scoring and stable completion, time and repeated observations. Low training loss is not closed-loop reliability.

blocks.zh: 沿箭头阅读，点击模块查看解释。
blocks.en: Follow the arrows and select modules for explanations.

blocks.zh: 好的示范不只是“最终进球”。如果每段都从完全相同的位置开始，模型可能不会处理小偏差；如果每段都反复低头犹豫，模型也可能学到这些多余动作。因此先让传统方案在同一场景的合理起点范围内准确、顺畅地完成任务，再把它作为示范来源。
blocks.en: Good demonstrations require more than eventually scoring. Identical starts leave small deviations uncovered, while repeated hesitation may teach unnecessary movements. First make the traditional method accurate and smooth over a reasonable range of starts on one field, then use it as a demonstration source.

blocks.zh: 拖动进度条，查看相机画面、115 维状态历史与随后执行的 4 维动作标签。这是仿真老师完成的一次示范，按仿真时间播放。低头时观察球，抬头后向球门方向推进并制动；前进与转向是官方轮滑技能的原生请求，不等于实测速度。展开样本可以看到当前身体状态、两段过去状态和上一动作；下节解释这些信息为什么有用。帧号和时间只用于检查对齐，不作为模型输入。
blocks.en: Seek through a recorded teacher demonstration to inspect RGB, the 115-dimensional state history and following four-dimensional action label. Playback follows simulation time. The teacher looks down at the ball, raises its gaze, propels toward the goal and brakes. Forward and yaw are native roller requests, not measured velocities. Expand the sample for current state, two past states and the previous action; the next section explains this context. Frame numbers and time are alignment metadata, not model inputs.

blocks.zh: 老师能完成任务，还不等于这些示范一定容易学。检查机器人做决定时实际能看到什么：例如推进时球是否仍在相机画面里，开始动作是否取决于能测到的头部姿态和身体稳定程度。如果两次图像与身体状态几乎相同，老师却仅因隐藏的计时或内部阶段发出不同动作，只看当前观察的模型就很难判断该选哪一个。改进观察方式、使用可观察的切换条件，或在模型接口中明确加入可部署的历史信息，比直接增加重复示范更有针对性。
blocks.en: A teacher completing a task does not automatically make its demonstrations easy to learn. Inspect what the learner can observe when deciding: whether the moving ball remains in view, and whether launch depends on measurable head pose and body stability. If nearly identical observations receive different labels only because of a hidden timer or internal phase, a current-observation policy cannot reliably distinguish them. Improve sensing, use observable transition conditions, or explicitly provide deployable history rather than only repeating more demonstrations.

title.zh: 增加示范：数量、覆盖与恢复要一起看
title.en: More demonstrations: quantity, coverage and recovery

blocks.zh: 先保持一个球场、一种地面和相同光照，改变机器人与足球的起点。训练集需要覆盖接近球、调整朝向、低头观察、准备出脚和站稳；几十条几乎相同的顺利轨迹，不能替代这些状态的覆盖。按完整回合分开训练、验证与测试，相邻视频帧不能被随机拆进不同集合。
blocks.en: Keep one field, floor and lighting setup first, while varying robot and ball starts. Cover approach, heading adjustment, looking down, kick preparation and stable recovery. Many nearly identical successful trajectories cannot replace state coverage. Split complete episodes, never adjacent frames, between training, validation and testing.

blocks.zh: 先看失败属于哪一类：找不到球、接近后反复后退、朝向尚未对准就出脚，还是触球后没有恢复站立。为常见失败设计能回到任务的示范。专家也必须能处理这些状态：从普通起点踢得好，不代表从球旁偏转的姿态也会恢复。保留所有尝试与失败原因，只把验证过的正确动作当作监督信号。
blocks.en: Classify failures first: losing the ball, repeatedly retreating after approach, kicking before alignment, or failing to recover after contact. Collect demonstrations that return these states to the task. The expert must handle them too: success from an ordinary start does not guarantee recovery beside the ball at an angle. Keep every attempt and failure reason; supervise only with verified correct behavior.

blocks.zh: 从不同起点重新运行专家属于扩大示范覆盖。只有先让学习策略进入实际状态、再连续交接给合格专家并记录纠正，才属于自动专家 DAgger；由人决定何时接管的才是 HG-DAgger。两种数据都需要与“只继续训练原始示范”的对照组比较，才能判断收益来自纠正数据还是额外训练。
blocks.en: Restarting an expert from varied initial states expands demonstration coverage. Automatic-expert DAgger instead lets the learner reach a state and hands control continuously to a qualified expert for recorded correction. HG-DAgger uses human-gated intervention. Compare correction training against continuing on the original demonstrations to distinguish the value of corrections from extra training.

title.zh: GR00T 值得吗？用六项实验回答

blocks.zh: 传统流程、小型视觉策略和 GR00T 是三种不同的任务实现方式。小型基线可以用预训练 ResNet18 提取四帧图像特征，用 GRU 汇总时间信息，再结合 127 维本体状态输出同样的 16×8 动作序列。单任务指令固定时，可以省略语言分支。它与 GR00T 复用相同的底层技能和动作执行节奏。
blocks.en: An engineered pipeline, a small visual policy and GR00T are three ways to implement a task. A small baseline can encode four images with pretrained ResNet18, aggregate them with a GRU, combine 127 proprioceptive values and predict the same 16×8 action sequence. A fixed single-task instruction permits omitting language. Both learners reuse the same motor skills and execution cadence.

zh: 冻结模型后，在同一批未用于训练和调参的回合中运行
进球且恢复站立才算完整成功；保留失败分母与置信区间
机器人与球的新位置组合；范围内和超出范围分别测
更换随机种子不等于更换起点
使用嵌套的 5、10、20、33 条示范，多次训练
每档从相同的预训练起点开始，不能继承大数据档的任务训练
测完整新预测的中位数与 P95，另测端到端延迟
取缓存动作的速度不等于模型推理速度
记录特征缓存、训练时间、显存和失败尝试的成本
预训练经验不是免费的从零学习；注明未计入的预训练成本
同一画面下，分别要求“踢进球门”和“走近球但不要碰球”
轻量基线也应获得任务 ID 或文本输入，不能剥夺它区分目标的信息
en: Freeze checkpoints, then run the same held-out episodes
Count goals with stable recovery; retain failures and confidence intervals
New robot/ball position combinations, with in-range and out-of-range suites separate
A new random seed alone is not a new start
Nested sets of 5, 10, 20 and 33 demonstrations, with repeated training seeds
Start each budget from the same pretrained initialization, never a larger-budget task checkpoint
Median and P95 of fresh predictions, plus separate end-to-end timing
Feature extraction, training, memory and failed-attempt compute
Disclose pretrained experience and excluded pretraining cost
Same scene, different goals: score versus approach without contact
Give the small baseline a task ID or text input too

blocks.zh: 先生成一份评测计划，检查两种学习方法是否使用相同输入、动作接口和测试起点。下面的命令只写入实验计划，不会训练模型，也不会生成成功率。将计划中的测试种子留给最终评测；不要用于采集示范或挑选参数。
blocks.en: Generate an evaluation plan first and check that both learners share inputs, action interfaces and test starts. The command below writes a plan; it does not train a model or produce a success rate. Reserve its test seeds for final evaluation, not demonstration collection or parameter selection.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code: python3 lab/learning/benchmark.py plan --seed 120000 --episodes 20 --output outputs/policy-comparison-plan.json

blocks.zh: 先建立单任务比较，再加入第二个目标。两条已知指令的正确选择、未见的同义表达、以及新的目标组合，是三个不同层次的泛化。若轻量策略在固定任务中更准确、更快，这也是有价值的结果；应根据实验判断何时需要 GR00T 的额外能力。
blocks.en: Establish the single-task comparison before adding a second goal. Choosing between known instructions, understanding unseen paraphrases and handling new goal combinations are distinct levels of generalization. If the small policy is more accurate and faster on the fixed task, that is useful evidence; experiments should determine when GR00T’s additional capabilities are worthwhile.

title.zh: 让模型知道刚才做过什么
title.en: Give the policy recent motion context

blocks.zh: 一张图像很难区分“还没有开始前进”和“刚刚停止”。本练习把短时身体状态加入输入，让模型观察运动的变化，而不是依靠一个隐藏的阶段编号。相机仍提供当前画面，历史部分不保存过去的图像。
blocks.en: A single image can make waiting before propulsion resemble stopping afterward. Recent body states provide motion context without a hidden phase identifier. The camera still supplies the current image; this history does not include earlier images.

blocks.zh: 每个身体状态 s 有 37 个数，分别是关节角、关节速度、身体角速度、重力方向和理想 IMU 积分速度。在 12.5 Hz 的采样频率下，过去 12 帧和 24 帧约对应 0.96 秒和 1.92 秒前；再加入上一帧实际执行的 4 维请求，总共是 115 维。刚复位时用第一帧实测状态补齐历史，上一动作设为零。
blocks.en: Each body state has 37 values: joint positions and velocities, body angular velocity, gravity direction and ideal IMU-integrated velocity. At 12.5 Hz, lags of 12 and 24 frames span 0.96 and 1.92 seconds. Adding the previous four-dimensional executed request gives 115 dimensions. A physical reset pads history with the first measured state and starts with a zero previous action.

blocks.zh: 采集、训练和运行时必须使用同样的状态定义。不要把本节的 115 维数据交给只接受 37 维输入的检查点；需要重新建立处理器并训练匹配的模型。时间戳用于对齐记录，不输入模型。真机上的 IMU 积分还会受偏置和噪声影响，不能把理想仿真的速度估计当成真机测量精度。
blocks.en: Collection, training and execution must share this state definition. A 37-dimensional checkpoint cannot use these 115-dimensional observations; fit matching processors and train a compatible policy. Timestamps align records but are excluded from the model. Hardware IMU integration has bias and noise, so ideal simulated estimates do not establish hardware accuracy.

question.zh: 为什么历史里要放上一帧实际执行的动作，而不是当前要预测的标签？
question.en: Why include the previous executed action rather than the current target label?

answer.zh: 上一动作在决策时已经发生，可以在真机上获得；当前标签还没有执行，把它作为输入会泄漏答案。
answer.en: The previous action has already happened and is available on hardware. Supplying the current target would leak the answer.

title.zh: 动手：准备 GR00T 学习环境

blocks.zh: 先完成课程环境准备。本章使用一个足球垫、固定球门和轮滑模式；先学习这一种任务，再讨论跨场景迁移。下面的命令另建学习环境，仿真仍使用课程配置的 Isaac Lab 与 Newton。 学习时长不含权重下载、数据采集与训练等待，实际耗时取决于你的电脑。
blocks.en: Complete the course setup first. Use one mat, a fixed goal and roller mode before studying transfer. The commands create a separate learning environment while simulation retains the configured Isaac Lab and Newton. Learning time excludes model downloads, data collection and training waits, which depend on your computer.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
python3 scripts/learning.py setup --variant groot --output .venv-groot
.venv-groot/bin/hf auth login

blocks.zh: 首次运行前，在 Hugging Face 的 nvidia/Cosmos-Reason2-2B 页面按账户提示开通访问；它提供 GR00T 1.7 所需的处理器资源。登录在本机终端完成。训练会下载 GR00T 权重，并保存模型与优化器检查点，请准备充足磁盘空间。
blocks.en: Enable access to nvidia/Cosmos-Reason2-2B on Hugging Face for the GR00T 1.7 processor resources. Sign in locally in the terminal. Training downloads the GR00T weights and stores model and optimizer checkpoints, so allow sufficient disk space.

title.zh: 动手：把仿真示范变成训练数据
title.en: Hands-on: turn simulation demonstrations into data

blocks.zh: 在仓库根目录运行下面的命令，分别采集训练与验证回合。先用两个相邻的横向起点记录示范，让模型接触轻微的接近差异。示范老师使用官方轮滑技能，并可读取仿真中的精确位置、球速和阶段时间；学习策略只接收图像、任务指令、身体状态历史与上一动作。训练和验证使用不同随机种子。
blocks.en: Collect separate training and validation episodes from the repository root, using two nearby lateral starts. The teacher uses the official roller skill and privileged simulated poses, ball velocity and phase time. The learner receives only RGB, task instructions, body-state history and the previous action. Use distinct train/validation seeds.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
python3 scripts/learning.py collect \
  --controller lab/learning/configs/roller-history-expert.json \
  --output outputs/demonstrations-train --episodes 6 --seed 60000 \
  --seconds 24 --root-x -0.30 --root-y 0.045 \
  --position-jitter 0.002 --split train --headless

python3 scripts/learning.py collect \
  --controller lab/learning/configs/roller-history-expert.json \
  --output outputs/demonstrations-validation --episodes 3 --seed 61000 \
  --seconds 24 --root-x -0.30 --root-y 0.045 \
  --position-jitter 0.002 --split validation --headless

python3 scripts/learning.py collect \
  --controller lab/learning/configs/roller-history-expert.json \
  --output outputs/demonstrations-aligned-train --episodes 10 --seed 88000 \
  --seconds 24 --root-x -0.30 --root-y 0.055 \
  --position-jitter 0.002 --split train --headless

python3 scripts/learning.py collect \
  --controller lab/learning/configs/roller-history-expert.json \
  --output outputs/demonstrations-aligned-validation --episodes 3 --seed 89000 \
  --seconds 24 --root-x -0.30 --root-y 0.055 \
  --position-jitter 0.002 --split validation --headless

blocks.zh: 先检查所有尝试，再导出合格示范。进球、未摔倒、未冲入球门区域和结束前连续停稳都要满足；只把球推过门线不够。accepted.json 列出合格回合，失败和仿真启动异常保留在各自记录中。若没有合格示范，先检查采集结果，不要跳过评分直接训练。下面的合并只在各自的数据划分内部进行；验证示范不会进入训练集。对新增站位，先确认训练采集的十次中至少八次完整成功且无摔倒，三次验证采集中至少两次完整成功且无摔倒，再继续导出。没有达到时先检查失败回合，不要仅凭少数成功片段判断老师可靠。
blocks.en: Inspect every attempt before exporting eligible demonstrations. Scoring, no fall, stopping before the goal and a continuous final stable interval are all required. accepted.json lists eligible episodes; failures and startup errors remain recorded. If none qualify, inspect collection rather than bypassing the score. Aggregation remains within each split; validation examples never enter training. For the added start, require at least eight complete successes with no falls in ten training attempts, and at least two complete successes with no falls in three validation attempts, before export. Otherwise inspect failures first; a few selected successes do not establish a reliable teacher.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
for collection in demonstrations-train demonstrations-validation demonstrations-aligned-train demonstrations-aligned-validation; do
  python3 lab/learning/data.py report "outputs/$collection"
done

for split in train validation; do
  .venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/data.py export \
    --manifest "outputs/demonstrations-$split/accepted.json" \
    --output "outputs/groot-data-original-$split" --source automatic_expert
  .venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/data.py export \
    --manifest "outputs/demonstrations-aligned-$split/accepted.json" \
    --output "outputs/groot-data-aligned-$split" --source automatic_expert
  .venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/data.py merge \
    --inputs "outputs/groot-data-original-$split" "outputs/groot-data-aligned-$split" \
    --output "outputs/groot-data-$split" --split "$split"
done

blocks.zh: 导出结果采用 LeRobot 数据格式，并保留来源与训练/验证划分。不要把同一回合换个目录名放入验证集，也不要把一段原始视频及其外观变体分到两侧。思考：为什么帧数很多，但只有很少起始条件的数据，仍可能让模型过拟合？
blocks.en: The export uses LeRobot format and retains source lineage and split information. Renaming an episode does not make it held-out; an original clip and its appearance variants must remain on the same side. Why can many frames from very few starting conditions still produce overfitting?

title.zh: 动手：微调动作模型

blocks.zh: 先用训练集建立输入输出处理器，再从官方 GR00T 1.7 权重开始适配。本实验冻结视觉语言骨干与动作 Transformer，训练连接 Microduck 状态和高层动作请求的投影层，以及动作序列的位置编码。下面的命令采用固定场景示范；训练完成后仍需独立测试。 --head-dropout disabled 关闭动作头的随机丢弃，用于先检验模型能否拟合这一固定场景；这是本实验的选择，不代表官方默认配置，也不能据此推断跨场景泛化能力。
blocks.en: Fit input/output processors on the training split, then adapt the official GR00T 1.7 weights. Freeze the vision-language backbone and action Transformer while training the Microduck state/action projections and action-position embeddings. Use the fixed-scene demonstrations, then evaluate independently. --head-dropout disabled removes action-head dropout to test fixed-scene fitting. This is an experiment-specific choice, not an official default or evidence of transfer.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
.venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/initialize.py \
  --dataset outputs/groot-data-train \
  --output outputs/groot-initialization

.venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/train_cached.py \
  --checkpoint outputs/groot-initialization \
  --initialization official-base --training-scope projectors \
  --head-dropout disabled --learning-rate 0.001 \
  --dataset outputs/groot-data-train \
  --validation-dataset outputs/groot-data-validation \
  --output outputs/groot-baseline \
  --steps 3000 --batch-size 16 --seed 47 --balanced-action-groups

blocks.zh: 程序会先计算并缓存冻结的视觉语言骨干特征，再开始更新动作模型。日志中的 cache 和 frames 表示特征准备进度，step 才表示优化器更新次数；看到缓存进度持续增长时，可以继续等待。首次更新后还会检查模型保存与重新加载，因此此处也可能有一段等待。缓存只适用于骨干不更新、图像预处理固定的情况，不能直接沿用于改变图像增强或解冻骨干的训练。
blocks.en: The program first computes and caches features from the frozen vision-language backbone, then updates the action model. The cache and frames log entries track feature preparation; step counts optimizer updates. Keep waiting while cache progress advances. A save-and-reload check after the first update may also take time. Feature caching requires a frozen backbone and fixed image preprocessing; it cannot be reused unchanged after adding image augmentation or unfreezing the backbone.

blocks.zh: 训练结束后，pretrained_model 目录包含模型、输入输出处理器和动作接口信息。模型保存与优化器保存也需要时间；日志到达最后一步时，不要立即关闭进程。下面的命令比较验证轨迹上的动作预测误差。
blocks.en: After training, pretrained_model contains weights, processors and the action contract. Saving model and optimizer state also takes time; do not close the process when the last update appears. The following command measures action prediction error on held-out trajectories.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
.venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/evaluate.py \
  --checkpoint outputs/groot-baseline/checkpoints/003000/pretrained_model \
  --dataset outputs/groot-data-validation \
  --output outputs/groot-validation.json --all-anchors --seed 42

blocks.zh: 分别阅读前进、转向、视线俯仰和视线权重的误差，不要把不同单位简单平均成一个“准确率”。这里的验证仍是对记录观察做预测：模型一旦自己执行，输入就会随它的动作改变，因此还需要下面的闭环测试。 --all-anchors 检查每一个有效观察起点，避免抽样漏掉开始推进和停车附近的动作变化；相邻动作块会重叠，它们不是独立试验。
blocks.en: Read each action error separately rather than averaging different units into one accuracy. This evaluation predicts from recorded observations. During execution the policy changes its own future inputs, which requires a closed-loop test. --all-anchors checks every valid observation anchor so subsampling does not skip propulsion and braking transitions. Adjacent chunks overlap and are not independent trials.

title.zh: 动手：让 GR00T 独立控制轮滑射门
title.en: Hands-on: let GR00T control the task

blocks.zh: 打开两个终端，都位于课程仓库根目录。第一个终端运行下面的命令，加载你刚训练的模型；保持它运行，直到服务提示准备就绪。
blocks.en: Open two terminals at the repository root. Start the trained model in the first terminal and keep it running until it reports readiness.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
.venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/server.py \
  --checkpoint outputs/groot-baseline/checkpoints/003000/pretrained_model \
  --log outputs/groot-inference.jsonl

blocks.zh: 在第二个终端执行下面的命令。这次控制请求来自 GR00T，不再由示范老师发出。官方轮滑技能与本地制动仍负责底层执行；新种子用于完整任务测试。
blocks.en: Run the next command in the second terminal. GR00T now supplies the requests; the demonstration teacher is inactive. The official roller skill and local braking still execute low-level control. New seeds are used for full-task evaluation.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
python3 scripts/learning.py collect \
  --controller lab/learning/configs/roller-history-policy.json \
  --output outputs/groot-test --episodes 10 --seed 82000 \
  --seconds 24 --root-x -0.30 --root-y 0.055 \
  --position-jitter 0.002 --split test --headless

python3 lab/learning/data.py report outputs/groot-test

blocks.zh: 先检查计划中的回合是否全部完成，再读完整任务成功数。启动异常需要单独处理，不能悄悄从结果里消失。这个小测试只反映同一场景、近似对齐起点的表现，不能证明能在任意房间找到球。仿真会等待每次推理返回；实际推理耗时记录在日志中，这种同步运行不代表真机已满足实时控制要求。保留所有十次结果；若需要根据失败调参，再选新的起点做后续独立测试，不要反复挑选同一组中的成功片段。
blocks.en: Check that all planned episodes completed, then read full-task successes. Startup failures need separate handling. This small test covers one scene and approximately aligned starts, not finding a ball in arbitrary rooms. Simulation waits for inference; measured latency is logged, and this synchronous test does not establish hardware real-time operation. Retain all ten outcomes. After tuning on failures, use fresh starts for a later independent test instead of selecting successes from the same trials.

title.zh: 偏离示范后怎么办：HG-DAgger 与自动专家
title.en: Recovering from drift: HG-DAgger and automated experts

blocks.zh: 模型第一次走偏后，看到的画面可能已经不在原示范里。例如轮滑稍微偏向球的一侧，继续模仿“正对球向前滑”的动作反而会越走越偏。这是只学习成功轨迹的常见短板：缺少“从错误状态回到任务”的经验。
blocks.en: After the first deviation, the policy may encounter observations absent from demonstrations. If skating drifts to one side, imitating a straight approach may worsen the error. Successful trajectories alone often omit recovery from off-course states.

blocks.zh: 本节通过流程图理解 HG-DAgger，不需要手动操纵机器人。仿真中的自动专家纠正采用同样的“收集偏差—补充正确动作—微调—独立复测”思路，但纠正动作由控制器提供，不能称为人类接管。
blocks.en: Use the diagram to understand HG-DAgger; no manual robot control is required. Automated expert correction in simulation follows the same collect–correct–fine-tune–retest loop, but its corrective actions come from a controller, not a human.

blocks.label: 让策略尝试，在需要时补充正确动作
details: 让学习策略访问真实会遇到的状态，而不是永远只重放理想轨迹。接管条件可以包括接近偏离、速度过大或目标丢失，但不应等到每次都已无法挽回。
HG-DAgger 由人判断何时接管并给出纠正动作。若传统控制器能可靠恢复这些偏差，也可由它充当自动专家：这是 DAgger 风格的自动专家纠正，而不是人类接管。
保留观察、策略建议、专家指令、实际执行动作与控制权标记。专家纠正成功的片段可作为标签；错误的自主动作、暂停与复位不能混成正确示范。动作块采样不能跨越不连续的片段边界。
收集期间模型通常保持固定，随后离线微调。最终关闭接管，单独测自主成功率；有人或专家帮忙完成的比例，不能当作模型独立能力。

english_diagram.label: Let the learner try, then supply corrective actions
details: Let the learner visit states it actually encounters rather than only replay ideal trajectories. Triggers may include drift, excess speed or a lost target, before recovery becomes impossible.

HG-DAgger uses human decisions and corrective actions. A reliable traditional recovery controller can instead provide automated expert corrections: a DAgger-style variant, not human-gated intervention.

Record observations, learner proposals, expert commands, executed actions and ownership. Successful expert segments provide labels; wrong autonomous actions, pauses and resets are not correct demonstrations. Chunks must not cross discontinuous segment boundaries.
Usually collect with fixed model weights, then fine-tune offline. Evaluate the new policy with intervention disabled. Assisted completion is not independent policy success.

blocks.zh: 沿箭头阅读，点击模块查看解释。
blocks.en: Follow the arrows and select modules for explanations.

blocks.zh: 对 Microduck，自动接管值得优先研究，因为可以复用已经验证的控制技能。但“标准起点很准”还不够：专家还要能处理球移动、朝向偏差、已有速度和短暂丢失目标。若专家不能从这些状态恢复，就先补它的恢复能力，或者停止并复位；不能把失败纠正继续喂给模型。
blocks.en: Automated takeover is worth studying for Microduck because it can reuse validated controls. High accuracy from standard starts is insufficient: the expert must handle moved balls, heading errors, existing motion and briefly lost targets. Improve recovery or stop/reset where it cannot recover; do not train on failed corrections.

blocks.zh: 双足机器人不能像固定机械臂那样简单暂停关节命令。切换控制权时，应清除旧动作队列，继续保持底层平衡或受控制动，并明确谁控制头部与身体。仿真中若用精确位置辅助专家，必须把它标为专家特权信息，不能悄悄混进未来真机策略的输入。
blocks.en: A biped cannot simply pause joint commands like a fixed-base arm. Clear stale action queues during takeover, maintain balance or controlled braking, and assign head/body ownership explicitly. If a simulation expert uses exact positions, label that privileged information and exclude it from the future real-robot policy inputs.

question.zh: 为什么“专家帮助后 20 次都成功”还不能证明模型已经学会？
question.en: Why do 20 assisted successes not prove the policy has learned?

answer.zh: 因为接管动作可能完成了最关键的纠错。应在关闭接管后重新测试自主成功率，同时另报接管次数与专家恢复率。
answer.en: The expert may have supplied the decisive recovery. Retest without intervention and report intervention frequency and expert recovery separately.

title.zh: 动手：从模型运行中采集自动制动纠正

blocks.zh: 本练习复用刚训练的 GR00T 基线，不需要键盘接管。自动专家只处理一种情况：球已经朝球门滚出，但模型仍请求前进。它借助仿真精确位置与球速判断时机，然后发出零前进请求，让原有制动控制器停车。它不会重新找球、纠正任意朝向或扶起摔倒的机器人。这是自动专家纠正，不是人类 HG-DAgger。
blocks.en: Reuse the trained GR00T baseline without keyboard intervention. The automatic expert handles one case: the ball has rolled toward the goal while the policy still requests propulsion. Privileged simulated poses and ball velocity trigger zero propulsion through the existing brake controller. It cannot search again, correct arbitrary headings or recover falls. This is automated expert correction, not human HG-DAgger.

blocks.zh: 若上一节同一个基线检查点的推理服务仍在运行，继续使用并跳过下面的启动命令；否则，在终端 A 启动服务并等待模型准备就绪。在终端 B 登记采集起点与所用模型，再采集全部 16 个回合。reference-episode 指向这个基线实际完成测试的回合，只用于识别模型与控制接口，不会加入训练集。
blocks.en: If the same baseline server from the previous exercise is still running, reuse it and skip the launch command below. Otherwise start it in terminal A and wait until ready. In terminal B, register the starts and model before collecting all 16 episodes. reference-episode identifies the model and control interface from its actual test recording; that test episode does not enter training.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
.venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/server.py \
  --checkpoint outputs/groot-baseline/checkpoints/003000/pretrained_model \
  --log outputs/automatic-correction-inference.jsonl

blocks.zh: 下面四条命令在第二个终端运行。登记与采集必须使用相同的起点、时长、随机种子和控制配置。
blocks.en: Run the four commands below in the second terminal. Registration and collection must use identical starts, duration, seeds and controller configuration.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
python3 lab/learning/qualify_expert.py plan \
  --controller lab/learning/configs/roller-history-automatic-brake.json \
  --reference-episode outputs/groot-test/episode-82000 \
  --seed 96000 --episodes 16 --seconds 24 \
  --root-x -0.30 --root-y 0.055 --position-jitter 0.002 \
  --output outputs/automatic-correction-plan.json

python3 scripts/learning.py collect \
  --controller lab/learning/configs/roller-history-automatic-brake.json \
  --output outputs/automatic-corrections --episodes 16 --seed 96000 \
  --seconds 24 --root-x -0.30 --root-y 0.055 --position-jitter 0.002 \
  --split correction --expert-protocol outputs/automatic-correction-plan.json --headless

python3 lab/learning/data.py report outputs/automatic-corrections
python3 lab/learning/qualify_expert.py qualify \
  --collection outputs/automatic-corrections \
  --plan outputs/automatic-correction-plan.json \
  --output outputs/automatic-correction-qualification.json

blocks.zh: 先看所有回合的结果，再看实际触发接管的数量。只有至少 3 次触发，且触发回合中至少 70% 最终完成进球与停稳，检查才通过。未触发、摔倒和未进球的回合都保留；触发后的完成比例不是模型独立成功率，也不能证明专家修好了某一次无接管时的失败。若 passed 为 false，先分析不足，不继续导出或微调。
blocks.en: Inspect every outcome and then the number of actual interventions. The check requires at least three triggered episodes and at least 70% complete scoring-and-stopping among them. Retain non-triggered runs, falls and misses. Conditional assisted completion is not autonomous policy success or proof of counterfactual rescue. If passed is false, analyze the limitation before exporting or training.

blocks.zh: 没有足够的接管不一定是坏事：模型可能已经及时停车，也可能在触球前就失败，超出了这个专家的能力。先区分这两种情况，再决定是否需要补充其他类型的纠正。
blocks.en: Too few interventions are not necessarily bad: the policy may already brake correctly, or may fail before contact, outside this expert’s scope. Distinguish these cases before designing another correction type.

title.zh: 动手：把合格纠正加入示范
title.en: Hands-on: add qualified corrections to demonstrations

blocks.zh: 检查通过后，下面的命令只选完整成功回合中的实际专家片段，每次最多保留接管后的 64 帧，减少长时间静止片段的重复。原始完整记录仍保留。历史状态延续接管前的实际运动，不在控制权切换时清零；模型建议和专家实际执行动作分别记录。
blocks.en: After the check passes, retain only actual expert segments from fully successful episodes, capped at the first 64 frames after each intervention to limit redundant stationary tails. Keep complete source recordings. State history continues through takeover instead of resetting, and learner proposals remain distinct from executed expert actions.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
python3 lab/learning/review.py \
  --qualified-recoveries outputs/automatic-correction-qualification.json \
  --max-frames 64 --output outputs/automatic-correction-manifest.json

.venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/data.py export \
  --manifest outputs/automatic-correction-manifest.json \
  --output outputs/groot-correction-data --source automatic_expert --corrections-only

.venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/data.py merge \
  --inputs outputs/groot-data-train outputs/groot-correction-data \
  --output outputs/groot-data-with-corrections

blocks.zh: 停止推理服务，再运行下面的两组训练。两组从同一个基线检查点出发，都更新 1000 步并使用相同参数；对照组只继续学习原示范，纠正组加入刚采集的专家片段。这个对照能减少额外训练量的混淆，但仍需独立物理测试来判断效果。优化器重新建立，输入输出的归一化统计沿用父模型。
blocks.en: Stop inference before training both branches. Start from the same baseline and match 1,000 updates and all training parameters. The control keeps original demonstrations; the correction branch adds the collected expert segments. This reduces the extra-training confound, while independent physical tests still determine the outcome. Optimizers are fresh; preprocessing statistics are inherited.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
for variant in control corrected; do
  dataset=outputs/groot-data-train
  if [ "$variant" = corrected ]; then
    dataset=outputs/groot-data-with-corrections
  fi
  .venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/train_cached.py \
    --checkpoint outputs/groot-baseline/checkpoints/003000/pretrained_model \
    --dataset "$dataset" --validation-dataset outputs/groot-data-validation \
    --output "outputs/groot-correction-$variant" \
    --steps 1000 --batch-size 16 --seed 49 --learning-rate 0.0002 \
    --training-scope projectors --head-dropout checkpoint --balanced-action-groups
done

title.zh: 动手：关闭专家，比较独立完成情况
title.en: Hands-on: compare performance without the expert

blocks.zh: 先在相同的验证示范上比较预测误差。两个模型都不能把验证回合用于训练；更低的误差仍不等于完整任务成功。
blocks.en: Compare prediction error on the same held-out demonstrations first. Neither branch may train on validation episodes; lower prediction error still does not establish complete-task success.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
for variant in control corrected; do
  .venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/evaluate.py \
    --checkpoint "outputs/groot-correction-$variant/checkpoints/001000/pretrained_model" \
    --dataset outputs/groot-data-validation \
    --output "outputs/groot-correction-$variant-offline.json" --all-anchors --seed 42
done

blocks.zh: 接着在终端 A 加载对照模型。等待服务准备就绪后，在终端 B 执行测试。完成后停止服务，把两个终端的 variant 都改为 corrected，再做相同测试；每次使用各自的新输出目录。
blocks.en: Load the control model in terminal A. Wait for readiness, then test in terminal B. Stop the server afterward, change variant to corrected in both terminals and repeat the matched test with its separate output directory.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
variant=control
.venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/server.py \
  --checkpoint "outputs/groot-correction-$variant/checkpoints/001000/pretrained_model" \
  --log "outputs/groot-correction-$variant-inference.jsonl"

blocks.zh: 第二个终端使用普通的 roller-history-policy.json，确保专家不再接管。五个新起点对两组保持一致，所有失败都计入结果。
blocks.en: Terminal B uses ordinary roller-history-policy.json with intervention disabled. Match the five fresh starts across branches and include every failure.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
variant=control
python3 scripts/learning.py collect \
  --controller lab/learning/configs/roller-history-policy.json \
  --output "outputs/groot-correction-$variant-test" --episodes 5 --seed 98000 \
  --seconds 24 --root-x -0.30 --root-y 0.055 --position-jitter 0.002 \
  --split test --headless
python3 lab/learning/data.py report "outputs/groot-correction-$variant-test"

blocks.zh: 比较完整进球并停稳的次数、摔倒次数和失败发生的位置。若纠正组没有改善，先检查错误是否真的发生在这个专家负责的制动阶段，以及新数据是否覆盖了模型常见的偏差。少量测试只能帮助发现问题，不能用来宣称所有错误都已解决。
blocks.en: Compare complete scoring-and-stopping, falls and where failures occur. If corrections do not help, check whether failures actually concern this expert’s braking scope and whether new data cover common learner deviations. A small test can reveal issues; it cannot establish universal recovery.

question.zh: 如果纠正组更早停下，但球仍未进门，能说自动纠正有效吗？
question.en: If the corrected policy stops earlier but the ball still misses, did correction succeed?

answer.zh: 不能仅凭提前停车下结论。最终任务还要求整球进门；需要区分制动改善与完整射门成功，并检查是否过早停止推进。
answer.en: Earlier braking alone is insufficient. The full task requires a whole-ball goal; distinguish braking behavior from complete success and check for prematurely ending propulsion.

title.zh: 把小鸭子与有算力的电脑连起来
title.en: Connect Microduck to a capable computer

blocks.zh: Microduck 的机载计算硬件不适合承载 GR00T 这类大 VLA 的推理。拿到真机后，可以让它与带合适 GPU 的电脑组成网络：小鸭子采集图像与状态，电脑运行模型，再把动作请求传回机器人。具体电脑需求应按模型、精度和实测延迟选择。
blocks.en: Microduck’s onboard computer is not suitable for running a large VLA such as GR00T. A real robot can communicate with a computer equipped with a suitable GPU: the robot streams images and state, the computer runs inference and returns action requests. Choose hardware based on the model, precision and measured latency.

blocks.label: 远端做模型推理，本地持续控制与反馈
nodes: 图像 + 状态 + 时间戳
details: 发送相机与机器人状态时保留采样时间和序号。不要把不同时间的姿态与图像拼成一次观察。
电脑根据最新有效观察生成动作段。网络传输、图像处理和模型计算都计入端到端延迟；服务器返回快，不等于机器人看到的是新画面。
机器人只接受符合约定、仍然有效的请求。底层控制持续运行；遇到超时或断网，应进入受控停止或稳定保持，避免继续执行过期的向前动作。

english_diagram.label: Remote inference with continuous local control and feedback
details: Preserve sample timestamps and sequence numbers. Do not combine unrelated image and state times as one observation.
Generate actions from the latest valid observation. Network, preprocessing and computation all contribute to end-to-end delay; a fast response can still be based on an old image.
Accept only valid, timely requests. Keep low-level control running; on timeouts or disconnection, use controlled stopping or stable holding instead of stale forward commands.

blocks.zh: 沿箭头阅读，点击模块查看解释。
blocks.en: Follow the arrows and select modules for explanations.

blocks.zh: 这也解释了为什么“大脑更聪明”不能替代控制工程：模型负责判断与动作预测，本地仍要及时维持平衡、管理动作时效并处理通信中断。下一章再把可靠动作能力交给智能体，组成更长的任务。
blocks.en: A smarter model does not remove control engineering. It predicts actions, while local execution maintains balance, manages freshness and handles interrupted communication. The next chapter lets an agent organize reliable action skills into longer tasks.

references.zh: DAgger：从策略访问的状态收集专家标签
references.en: DAgger: expert labels on learner-visited states

title.zh: 用 ASPIRE 组织任务并积累技能
title.en: Organize tasks and accumulate skills with ASPIRE

summary.zh: 当机器人已经有可靠技能，怎样用执行反馈改进任务程序，并把经验保留下来？
summary.en: Once reliable skills exist, how can execution feedback improve task programs and retain reusable experience?

meta.zh: 第 8 章 · 预计学习时长 25 分钟

title.zh: 聪明的大脑还需要可靠的动作
title.en: A capable agent needs reliable actions

blocks.zh: 上一章的 VLA 解决“根据当前观察怎样动作”。更长的任务还会遇到另一类问题：先找球还是先看门？球偏了怎样重试？完成一次射门后怎样换一个目标？这些判断可以由机器人智能体组织，把语言目标连接到可执行技能。
blocks.en: The VLA addresses actions from current observations. Longer tasks add decisions: find the ball or inspect the goal first, recover after a miss, or move to another target after scoring. A robot agent can organize such decisions by connecting language goals to executable skills.

blocks.label: 智能体组织任务，控制器持续执行
details: 指令描述结果，允许智能体选择实现方法。任务完成仍要有可观察的标准，例如整球越线且机器人稳定结束。
智能体调用已定义的观察与动作工具，安排顺序并处理失败。工具能做什么，决定了智能体实际能执行什么。
底层运动控制负责及时响应。可以先调用传统控制，之后再接入经过检验的 GR00T 技能；替换时仍要保持输入输出含义一致。
返回结构化结果与必要的图像，让智能体区分“没看见球”“动作未到位”和“进球但没停稳”。只有一句成功或失败，通常不足以改进程序。

english_diagram.label: The agent organizes the task; controllers keep executing
nodes: Send the ball into the goal
details: The instruction states the outcome while leaving methods open. Completion needs observable criteria, such as whole-ball crossing and stable termination.
The agent sequences defined observation/action tools and handles failures. Its executable abilities are bounded by those tools.
Low-level motion responds promptly. Begin with traditional controls and later introduce validated GR00T skills with compatible interfaces.
Return structured outcomes and relevant images to distinguish missed detection, inaccurate motion and failed stopping. A single success flag rarely explains a useful repair.

blocks.zh: 沿箭头阅读，点击模块查看解释。
blocks.en: Follow the arrows and select modules for explanations.

title.zh: ASPIRE：尝试、诊断、改进并复用
title.en: ASPIRE: try, diagnose, improve and reuse

blocks.zh: ASPIRE 是 NVIDIA 开源的机器人技能发现框架。它让智能体编写和改进控制程序，查看执行记录，定位失败，再通过重试检验修改。通过验证的经验被整理成可复用技能，帮助后续任务。这里的主要学习对象是程序和技能经验；这与 GR00T 通过训练更新神经网络参数不同。
blocks.en: ASPIRE is NVIDIA’s open robot-skill discovery framework. An agent writes and revises control programs, inspects execution traces, diagnoses failure and tests repairs. Validated experience becomes reusable skills for later tasks. This improves programs and skill knowledge, unlike GR00T training that updates neural parameters.

blocks.label: 执行结果决定哪些经验值得保留
nodes: 调用已有感知与动作工具
保留可重复成功的技能
details: 例如先观察，再调用短距离接近，最后检查球的位置。程序必须使用执行端真实提供的工具，而不是臆造一个“必定射门成功”的接口。
保留每次工具调用前后的观察，才能把“要求转向”和“身体实际转了多少”联系起来。仿真允许在明确的范围内反复试验。
如果球已经进门但机器人继续向前，应该检查制动与完成条件；反复调用视觉检测未必解决问题。修改应有具体假设。
在没有用于修补程序的新起点上检验，再保存适用条件、调用方法与恢复经验。记住一次成功的参数，不等于获得通用技能。

english_diagram.label: Execution results determine which experience to retain
details: For example: observe, request a short approach, then check ball position. Programs must use real execution tools, not an imaginary always-successful shot command.
Record observations around tool calls to connect requested turning to actual movement. Simulation enables repeated, bounded experimentation.
If the ball scores but the robot keeps moving, investigate braking and termination; more detection calls may not help. Each repair needs a specific hypothesis.
Evaluate on starts not used for repairs, then retain applicability, usage and recovery guidance. Remembering one successful parameter set is not a general skill.

blocks.zh: 沿箭头阅读，点击模块查看解释。
blocks.en: Follow the arrows and select modules for explanations.

blocks.zh: 对 Microduck，先在同一个简单球场验证观察、短距离移动、受控停车和结果判断，再组成完整射门。智能体推理或等待网络时，底层平衡控制仍要运行。更换场地与更长任务，应建立在这些基础能力可靠之后。
blocks.en: For Microduck, first validate observation, short movements, controlled stopping and outcome checks on the same simple field, then compose a complete shot. Balancing continues while the agent reasons or waits for network responses. New environments and longer tasks build on those reliable capabilities.

title.zh: GR00T 与 ASPIRE 怎样配合

zh: 调用什么能力，如何检查和改进
观察球偏向一侧，选择重定位后再试
给定观察，下一段怎样动作
根据图像与状态生成接近或碰球动作
怎样及时而稳定地执行
维持平衡、限幅、制动与动作超时处理
en: What to invoke, check and improve
Choose to reposition after observing an offset ball
How to execute promptly and stably

blocks.zh: 这个分层设计允许逐步替换能力，而不必一次让大模型接管所有关节。大模型也不会自动消除坐标、时间和单位问题；这些细节应封装在清晰的工具接口里，让智能体可以组合使用。
blocks.en: This hierarchy allows gradual replacement of capabilities without giving a large model every joint at once. Coordinates, timing and units still matter; clear tool interfaces encapsulate those details so the agent can compose them.

title.zh: 扩展阅读：Agnes Harness

blocks.zh: Agnes Harness 也围绕模型、工具与执行反馈组织机器人任务，其设备接入与插件设计值得作为扩展阅读。阅读这类框架时，可以比较三个问题：工具如何连接机器人，执行结果如何返回，失败经验怎样复用。比较时，重点观察两种框架怎样把执行反馈转化为可复用的能力。
blocks.en: Agnes Harness also organizes robot tasks around models, tools and feedback. Its device integration and plugin design are useful further reading. Compare how tools connect to robots, how results return and how failures inform reuse. ASPIRE supplies this chapter’s main skill-discovery methodology.

question.zh: 让智能体不停尝试，是否就等于机器人能力会持续提高？
question.en: Does unlimited retrying guarantee improving capability?

answer.zh: 不等于。需要可靠的动作工具、可诊断的反馈、有限的尝试预算，以及未参与修补的新测试。只有能重复验证的改进，才适合保留为技能。
answer.en: No. It needs reliable tools, diagnostic feedback, bounded attempts and tests excluded from repairs. Keep improvements that reproduce under evaluation.

references.zh: ASPIRE 官方源码与当前工作流

references.en: Agnes Harness architecture and device integration

title.zh: 从一个球场走向更多环境
title.en: From one field to more environments

summary.zh: 先判断失败来自哪里，再选择纠正示范、物理校准或 Cosmos 3 数据扩展；逐步检验新环境中的泛化。
summary.en: Diagnose failures before choosing corrections, physics calibration or Cosmos 3 data expansion; evaluate generalization step by step.

meta.zh: 第 9 章 · 预计学习时长 60 分钟

title.zh: 先把一个场景做可靠

blocks.zh: 先固定一种足球场地垫、背景与道具，让传统方案成为可靠基线，再检验 GR00T 的独立执行和 ASPIRE 的技能组织。这个顺序让问题容易解释：如果连原场景都不能稳定完成，增加十种房间通常只会让失败更难定位。
blocks.en: Fix one mat, background and set of props. Establish a reliable traditional baseline, then evaluate independent GR00T execution and ASPIRE skill organization. This order makes failures interpretable: if the original scene is unreliable, adding ten rooms usually makes diagnosis harder.

blocks.zh: 当同场景的新起点、轻微球位偏差和完整停车都已能稳定处理，再问“换一个家还能不能用”。不同家庭的光线、背景、布局和地面确实会变化，但不必一次把所有因素加入训练。
blocks.en: After reliable handling of fresh starts, modest ball offsets and complete stopping on one field, ask whether the system transfers to another home. Lighting, background, layout and surfaces do vary, but training need not change every factor at once.

title.zh: 先随机起点，再扩展房间
title.en: Vary initial states before expanding rooms

blocks.zh: 域随机化不只是换地板颜色。机器人起始位置与朝向、足球位置也会改变观察和动作需求。先在同一球场内改变机器人与球的位置，验证能否从未见过的组合完成任务；再扩大朝向和距离范围，最后引入室内背景、光照与地面外观。
blocks.en: Domain randomization is more than recoloring a floor. Robot position and heading, and ball position, change both observations and required actions. First vary robot/ball positions on one field and test unseen combinations. Then widen heading and distance ranges before adding room backgrounds, lighting and floor appearance.

blocks.zh: 位置或动力学发生变化后，要重新运行物理仿真并记录相应动作，不能直接沿用原轨迹标签。Cosmos 改变视觉外观时也要逐帧检查球、球门、相机视角与动作时序是否仍对齐。提高同一场景的闭环成功率之后，再判断多场景数据能否带来额外收益。
blocks.en: Changed positions or dynamics require new physical rollouts and matching action labels. For Cosmos appearance changes, inspect every frame to ensure ball, goal, camera and action timing remain aligned. Improve closed-loop reliability in one scene before testing the additional benefit of multiple scenes.

title.zh: 先分清外观问题与动作问题

zh: 视觉数据覆盖与外观随机化
把球门材质随机化就能解决一切
看见球，却从侧面越走越偏
多生成背景图就能学会恢复
球进门，但机器人停不住
制动控制、动力学与时延校准
图像更真实就能自动停稳
家具挡路，原路线不可用
布局变化与可执行的避障技能
只换地面贴图就能学会导航
en: Ball is missed under new light
Random goal materials fix every failure
Ball is seen but approach drifts
Ball scores but robot cannot stop

blocks.zh: 域随机化（Domain Randomization）是在训练时改变选定条件，让模型减少对单一环境的依赖。外观随机化改变看到的样子，动力学随机化改变真实运动，两者要分别设计。门框材质保持固定；地面扩展可先考虑两种足球场图案、大理石与棕色木地板。
blocks.en: Domain randomization changes selected training conditions to reduce dependence on one environment. Appearance variation changes images; dynamics variation changes motion. Design them separately. Keep goal-frame material fixed; possible floor expansion includes two football patterns, marble and brown wood.

title.zh: Cosmos 3：为同一动作补充视觉变化
title.en: Cosmos 3: visual variation for an action sequence

blocks.zh: Cosmos 3 是可用于理解和生成世界相关数据的多模态模型家族。对本任务，一个适合研究的入口是 video transfer：以已有仿真视频为基础，用边缘、深度或分割等条件约束内容，生成不同光照与室内外观的候选视频。
blocks.en: Cosmos 3 is an omnimodal family for understanding and generating world-related data. One relevant research path is video transfer: use existing simulation video with controls such as edges, depth or segmentation to generate candidate lighting and interior variations.

blocks.label: 改变视觉外观，检查动作标签是否仍然成立
nodes: 生成受条件约束的外观
陌生环境中的自主成功
details: 源数据首先要有正确动作和时间对应关系。原示范没有教会停车，改变它的外观也不会补出停车技能。
用结构条件帮助保持布局，再改变光照或房间外观。生成是候选数据生产过程，条件约束并不保证每一帧都正确。
检查球大小、门柱位置、机器人形状、接触时刻与跨帧连续性。如果球被生成到脚的另一侧，原动作标签就可能不再适用，应拒绝这段数据。
在相同示范量与训练预算下，与不增加生成数据的策略比较。把新房间或新组合留给测试，才能判断扩展是否有帮助。

english_diagram.label: Vary appearance and check whether action labels remain valid
details: Source data need correct actions and timing. Restyling a demonstration without braking skill does not add that skill.
Structural controls help preserve layout while appearance changes. Outputs remain candidates: conditioning does not guarantee every frame is correct.
Inspect ball scale, posts, robot shape, contact time and temporal continuity. If a ball moves to the other side of a foot, the old action label may be invalid; reject the segment.
Compare against training without generated data under matched data and compute budgets. Hold out rooms or combinations to evaluate the benefit.

blocks.zh: 沿箭头阅读，点击模块查看解释。
blocks.en: Follow the arrows and select modules for explanations.

blocks.zh: 生成视频不是一次新的物理实验。更漂亮的进球画面不能证明动作可执行；可靠性仍要回到闭环仿真，以及之后的真机测试。涉及摩擦、质量或制动距离的变化，要用物理参数与实测来处理。
blocks.en: Generated video is not a new physics experiment. A prettier goal does not establish executable actions; reliability still needs closed-loop simulation and later hardware tests. Friction, mass and braking-distance changes require physics parameters and measurements.

title.zh: 动手：为同一段动作改变光照
title.en: Hands-on: change lighting for the same actions

blocks.zh: 先完成第七章的示范采集、GR00T 训练和独立物理测试。只有模型在同一球场的新起点下已能稳定进球并停稳，才进入光照增强；若仍常常走偏、射程不足或停不稳，先处理动作与示范问题。本练习的目标是在保留场地、物体、相机运动与动作时序的前提下改变光照。Cosmos 生成候选画面，之后微调的仍是 GR00T。本练习采用一个保守的起点：十次新起点测试至少八次完整成功且没有摔倒；这个小测试不是家庭环境泛化的证明。 本章学习时长不含下载、视频生成、训练与物理测试的等待时间；这些耗时取决于设备。
blocks.en: First complete Chapter 7 demonstration collection, GR00T training and independent physical evaluation. Proceed to lighting augmentation only after reliable scoring and stopping at fresh starts on the same field. Address action or demonstration failures first if it still drifts, shoots short or cannot stop. The goal is to change lighting while retaining the scene, objects, camera motion and action timing. Cosmos generates candidate images; GR00T is fine-tuned afterward. As a starting check, require at least eight complete successes and no falls in ten fresh trials. This small fixed-scene test does not establish generalization to homes. Estimated learning time excludes downloads, video generation, training and physical-test waiting time, which depends on the computer.

blocks.zh: 先停止仿真和模型推理服务，再执行下面的命令创建生成环境。首次使用时登录 Hugging Face，并按模型页面提示开通 nvidia/Cosmos3-Nano 与 nvidia/Cosmos-1.0-Guardrail 的访问。
blocks.en: Stop simulation and the policy server before creating the generation environment. Sign in to Hugging Face and follow access requirements for nvidia/Cosmos3-Nano and nvidia/Cosmos-1.0-Guardrail.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
python3 scripts/learning.py setup --variant cosmos --output .venv-cosmos
.venv-cosmos/bin/hf auth login

blocks.zh: 从新增站位的训练示范 accepted.json 中选择一个完整成功回合，把下面路径替换为该回合目录。截取第 20 帧起连续 81 帧，在 12.5 Hz 下约为 6.5 秒，覆盖低头观察、推进到制动的过程；这段素材本身不需要包含最终进球。不要从验证集或测试集取素材。
blocks.en: Choose a complete success from the added-start training accepted.json and replace the episode path below. Extract 81 consecutive frames from frame 20: about 6.5 seconds at 12.5 Hz, spanning observation, propulsion and braking. This material does not need to include the final goal. Never source augmentation from validation or test episodes.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
.venv-cosmos/bin/python lab/learning/cosmos_data.py prepare \
  --training-dataset outputs/groot-data-train \
  --episode outputs/demonstrations-aligned-train/episode-88000 \
  --output outputs/cosmos-lighting --start 20 --frames 81

blocks.zh: 第 20 至 100 帧对应原始时间 1.60–8.00 秒：81 帧按 12.5 Hz 播放约 6.48 秒，首末观察相隔 6.40 秒。这是同一回合的连续片段，不是 81 次独立射门。先检查你选择的示范在这段时间内实际完成了哪些动作；片段结束并不代表整球已经进门。
blocks.en: Frames 20–100 correspond to source time 1.60–8.00 seconds: 81 frames play for about 6.48 seconds at 12.5 Hz, while first and last observations are 6.40 seconds apart. This is one contiguous episode segment, not 81 independent shots. Inspect which actions your selected demonstration contains; the clip ending does not establish a whole-ball goal.

blocks.zh: 下面的命令用边缘视频约束原有结构，并描述温和的室内光照变化。控制条件能帮助保持几何，但不能保证每一帧都正确。
blocks.en: The following command constrains structure with the edge video and requests a gentle lighting change. Conditioning helps preserve geometry but does not guarantee every frame is valid.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
.venv-cosmos/bin/python lab/learning/cosmos_data.py generate \
  --clip outputs/cosmos-lighting --seed 2026 --steps 50 \
  --prompt "A small black-and-white football and a miniature sloped-back goal on the same green football mat, viewed by the same moving robot camera. Soft cool indoor daylight at slightly lower brightness. Preserve every object position, scale, shape, camera viewpoint and motion from the control video. Keep the same plain indoor background."

title.zh: 动手：检查哪些生成画面可以沿用动作标签
title.en: Hands-on: decide whether labels remain valid

blocks.zh: 打开生成目录中的 review.html，逐帧比较原图与生成图。先看球和球门是否移动、变形或增减，再检查遮挡与运动是否连续。review.png 只抽取了少量画面，不能替代完整检查。生成视频不是一次新的物理射门试验。
blocks.en: Open review.html in the generated directory and compare every source/generated pair. Check object positions, shape, count, occlusion and temporal continuity. review.png is only a sampled overview. Generated video is not a new physical rollout.

blocks.zh: 完整检查后再选择 accept 或 reject，并填写你实际观察到的依据。球、球门、相机视角或帧间时序有不一致时，选择 reject；被拒绝片段原地保留，不继续执行后面的导出与训练命令。若再生成候选，使用新目录，不覆盖这次记录。人工检查是数据筛选，不能保证后续训练或物理测试一定成功。
blocks.en: After inspecting every frame, choose accept or reject and record what you actually observed. Reject mismatched ball/goal geometry, camera viewpoint or temporal alignment. Retain rejected clips and do not run the export/training steps below for them. Use a new directory for another candidate. Manual review filters data; it does not guarantee downstream training or physical success.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
python3 lab/learning/cosmos_data.py review \
  --clip outputs/cosmos-lighting --decision accept \
  --reviewer learner --inspected-all-frames \
  --reason "Checked every frame: object geometry and action timing remain aligned."

blocks.zh: 下面的命令为通过检查的片段创建清单，复用原始身体状态与动作标签，并与原示范合并。原片和生成变体始终属于训练集，不能把变体当作独立验证。
blocks.en: Create a manifest for the accepted clip, reuse its original states and actions, and aggregate it with demonstrations. Originals and generated variants remain in training; variants are not held-out validation.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
python3 lab/learning/cosmos_data.py manifest \
  --clip outputs/cosmos-lighting --output outputs/cosmos-manifest.json

.venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/data.py export \
  --manifest outputs/cosmos-manifest.json \
  --output outputs/groot-lighting-data --source automatic_expert

.venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/data.py merge \
  --inputs outputs/groot-data-train outputs/groot-lighting-data \
  --output outputs/groot-data-with-lighting

blocks.zh: 思考：为什么改变灯光后可能沿用原动作，而把地毯换成更滑的地面就不能直接沿用原来的速度与停车标签？后一种变化需要重新运行物理仿真。
blocks.en: Why might lighting variants reuse actions while a more slippery floor cannot reuse the original speeds and stopping labels? The latter needs a new physics rollout.

title.zh: 动手：比较有无生成数据的训练
title.en: Hands-on: compare training with and without generated data

blocks.zh: 数据通过检查后，从第七章同一个已训练检查点分别开始两次微调：对照组只用原示范，增强组加入审阅后的生成片段。两组都更新1000步，批量大小16、学习率0.0002、随机种子49、可训练参数范围及采样方式相同，并沿用父检查点的预处理统计。这里重新建立优化器，不是恢复原优化器状态。这个对照减少“只是多训练了一段时间”的混淆，结果仍需独立检验。
blocks.en: After accepting the data, start both fine-tuning runs from the same Chapter 7 checkpoint: original demonstrations only versus originals plus the reviewed clip. Match 1,000 updates, batch size 16, learning rate 0.0002, seed 49, trainable scope and sampling method, and reuse the parent checkpoint preprocessing statistics. Each run creates a fresh optimizer rather than resuming its state. This reduces the extra-training confound; results still need independent evaluation.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
for variant in control lighting; do
  dataset=outputs/groot-data-train
  if [ "$variant" = lighting ]; then
    dataset=outputs/groot-data-with-lighting
  fi
  .venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/train_cached.py \
    --checkpoint outputs/groot-baseline/checkpoints/003000/pretrained_model \
    --initialization checkpoint \
    --dataset "$dataset" --validation-dataset outputs/groot-data-validation \
    --output "outputs/groot-$variant" \
    --steps 1000 --batch-size 16 --seed 49 --learning-rate .0002 \
    --training-scope projectors --head-dropout checkpoint \
    --balanced-action-groups
done

blocks.zh: 这组命令接续第七章的 115 维状态历史、4 维高层请求和 roller-history-policy.json。生成片段复用同一回合的状态与动作，合并前会检查控制接口。训练集、验证集、父检查点和策略配置必须使用同样的历史定义，不能混入 37 维检查点。两组都使用相同的动作类别均衡采样；片段帧数不等于实际抽样占比。损失下降不代表完整任务成功。
blocks.en: Continue Chapter 7 with the same 115-dimensional state history, four-dimensional requests and roller-history-policy.json. Generated frames reuse the original episode states and actions, and aggregation checks the control interface. Training, validation, parent checkpoint and controller must share the history definition; do not mix in a 37-dimensional checkpoint. Both groups use the same action-balanced sampling, so frame fraction is not sampling probability. Lower loss does not establish task success.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
for variant in control lighting; do
  .venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/evaluate.py \
    --checkpoint "outputs/groot-$variant/checkpoints/001000/pretrained_model" \
    --dataset outputs/groot-data-validation \
    --output "outputs/groot-$variant-offline.json" --all-anchors --seed 42
done

blocks.zh: 接下来分别测试两组模型。先检查原来的 daylight 光照是否退步，再测试 cool-dim。后者由 Isaac Sim 独立配置冷暗照明，与生成提示词的方向相近，但不是对生成画面的数值匹配。仿真器重新渲染传感器画面并推进物理，不把生成视频回放给策略；测试的起点和轨迹没有用于训练。
blocks.en: Test both models under daylight for regressions, then under cool-dim. Isaac Sim independently configures cooler, dimmer lighting, similar in intent to the generation prompt but not a numerical match to generated pixels. It renders fresh sensor observations and advances physics instead of replaying generated video. These test starts and trajectories were excluded from training.

blocks.zh: 在终端A设置variant=control并启动下面的服务。等待模型加载完成后，在终端B运行测试。两种光照均测试完后，在终端A按Ctrl+C停止服务，再把两个终端中的variant都改为lighting，重复完整流程。每次只运行一个推理服务和对应仿真；每组使用自己的日志和输出目录。
blocks.en: In Terminal A, set variant=control and start the server below. Once loading finishes, run the tests in Terminal B. After testing both lighting profiles, stop the server with Ctrl+C, change variant to lighting in both terminals and repeat. Run only one policy server and its simulation at a time; keep separate logs and output directories.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
variant=control
.venv-groot/bin/python lab/learning/server.py \
  --checkpoint "outputs/groot-$variant/checkpoints/001000/pretrained_model" \
  --log "outputs/groot-$variant-inference.jsonl"

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
variant=control
for lighting in daylight cool-dim; do
  python3 scripts/learning.py collect \
    --controller lab/learning/configs/roller-history-policy.json \
    --output "outputs/$variant-$lighting" \
    --episodes 5 --seed 94000 --seconds 24 \
    --root-x -.30 --root-y .055 --position-jitter .002 \
    --style A --lighting "$lighting" --split test --headless
  python3 lab/learning/data.py report "outputs/$variant-$lighting"
done

blocks.zh: 两组保持相同的五个新起点和场景参数，全部尝试都保留。分别记录每组、每种光照下的完整成功数、进球数、摔倒数和完成测试数；遇到启动异常，先解决并保留记录，不能只统计顺利启动的成功片段。仍使用整球进门、不摔倒、不越过停车边界且结束前连续停稳的原判据。
blocks.en: Use the same five fresh starts and scene settings for both models and retain all attempts. Record completed trials, full successes, goals and falls for each model/lighting combination. Resolve and retain startup failures rather than reporting only successful fragments. Keep the original whole-ball goal, no fall, no stop-boundary crossing and continuous final stop criteria.

blocks.zh: 五次测试可以帮助发现明显问题，但不能证明已适应所有家庭环境。同种子也不保证物理轨迹逐位相同，不能把单次结果变化当作严格的反事实救回。如果增强组没有改善，检查生成画面是否保留任务线索，以及失败是否其实来自动作时机、接触或制动。不要为得到更好的表格反复更换片段和测试种子。
blocks.en: Five trials can expose obvious problems but do not establish generalization to all homes. Matching seeds do not guarantee bitwise-identical physical trajectories; a changed single outcome is not a strict counterfactual rescue. If augmentation does not help, inspect image cues and action timing, contact or braking failures. Do not repeatedly change clips and test seeds to obtain a better table.

title.zh: 扩展到机器人、场景与任务组合

blocks.zh: Isaac Lab-Arena 将环境分成 Scene（场景）、Embodiment（机器人、传感器与动作）和 Task（目标与完成判据），便于组合评测与数据采集。Isaac Lab 组织学习环境，Newton 推进物理，渲染器产生图像；OSMO 可以编排数据生成、训练与评测等计算工作流。
blocks.en: Isaac Lab-Arena separates Scene, Embodiment (robot, sensors and actions), and Task (goals and completion criteria) for compositional evaluation and data collection. Isaac Lab organizes learning environments, Newton advances physics and a renderer produces images. OSMO can orchestrate data generation, training and evaluation workflows.

blocks.zh: 组合不是任意拼接：机器人必须具备任务需要的传感器和动作，评测标准也要明确。步行与轮滑属于同一 Microduck 的两种模式，应分别评测；多环境同时运行，也不等于已经训练出能控制所有机器人的统一模型。
blocks.en: Combinations require compatible sensors, actions and clear evaluation criteria. Walking and skating are two modes of one Microduck, evaluated separately. Running environments concurrently does not itself produce one policy controlling every robot.

blocks.zh:
试着规划一组评测

这只是组合计数器，不启动仿真或训练。取消一项表示固定为一种条件。
blocks.en:
Design an evaluation matrix

This only counts combinations; it launches no simulation or training. Unchecking a factor fixes it to one condition.

title.zh: 逐步扩大，而不是一次全随机
title.en: Expand one factor at a time

blocks.zh: 一个合理顺序是：同一球场稳定完成 → 少量光照变化 → 新地面外观 → 新室内布局 → 有测量依据的动力学变化。每一步保留前一步作为对照，用同样的完整成功判据比较。若新变化带来的主要失败是看不清，就补视觉覆盖；若是走偏或停不稳，就回到纠正示范或控制与校准。
blocks.en: A useful progression is: stable completion on one field → modest lighting variation → new floor appearance → new room layouts → measured dynamics variation. Keep the previous stage as a baseline with the same complete-success criteria. Add visual coverage for perception failures, or revisit corrections and control calibration for drift and braking.

question.zh: 同一组动作的视频换了十种背景，就等于获得十倍不同的动作经验吗？
question.en: Do ten restyled backgrounds provide ten times the action experience?

answer.zh: 不等于。它扩充了视觉条件，但动作和状态覆盖可能仍相同。恢复偏差、改变路线或适应制动，需要对应的新轨迹或纠正数据。
answer.en: No. Visual conditions expand, but action/state coverage may remain unchanged. Recovery, new routes and braking need corresponding trajectories or corrections.

title.zh: 常见问题

zh: 使用 GPU 机器的桌面终端；检查 DISPLAY 和驱动，不要将纯命令行远程会话当作图形桌面。
查看日志是否仍在下载资源或编译；等待初始化，不要反复启动多个实例。
若 TorchCodec 加载失败后显示 Falling back to 'pyav'，且读取或训练进度仍在增长，程序已切换到另一种视频解码方式，可以继续等待。若进程退出或视频仍无法读取，请保留完整报错并检查第 7 章的学习环境。
为新实验使用新的目录名，并保留上一次运行的结果。
先减少学生训练的环境数或检测 batch；不要同时运行多个仿真。
重新获取仓库中的原模型，确认没有覆盖固定文件。
自训练模型行走效果不佳
短训练仅用于体验流程，不保证策略表现。比较奖励、回合长度和独立测试表现；下一章继续使用固定模型。
机器人停止或没有进球
查看任务结果和观测有效性。信息不足时，停止可能是正确行为，但不能据此判定射门成功。
en: Use the GPU desktop terminal and check DISPLAY and the driver. A remote text shell is not a graphical desktop.
Check for downloads and compilation. Allow initialization and avoid starting duplicate instances.

If a TorchCodec loading error is followed by Falling back to 'pyav' and reading or training continues to progress, an alternative video decoder is active; keep waiting. If the process exits or videos still cannot be read, retain the full error and check the Chapter 7 learning environment.
Choose a new run name and preserve the previous result.
Reduce training environments or detector batch size. Avoid concurrent simulations.
Restore the repository model and check for accidental overwrites.
A short run teaches the workflow. Inspect reward, episode length, and evaluation. Continue with fixed models.
Robot stops or does not score
Inspect the task report and observation validity. Stopping can be appropriate when information is missing; it is not a goal.
